dataset_ref.resolved_from: the local HuggingFace hub cache, offline (HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1)
dataset_ref.note: the revision pins the exact bytes and is reproducible anywhere; the local directory is deliberately not recorded (see provenance.py)

manifest.vector_rounding: 6 decimal places - the only lossy step in this file
manifest.error_vector_definition: d = W_U[wrong] - W_U[true]; g = dot(z, d) = logit_wrong - logit_true; e = (g/dot(d,d))*d. e is BOTH the component of z pointing toward the wrong answer rather than the true one AND the negation of the minimum-norm change to z that would flip the answer - the same vector. ||e|| = g/||d||. g > 0 is a miss, g < 0 is a correct answer.
manifest.no_cosine: Every comparison in this dump is a dot product or a norm. The final-layer residual's magnitude is what turns a direction into a logit, so cosine would discard the answer (R-VS-DEPTH; .opus-tools/autobot/vector_depth.py).
manifest.z_is: hidden_states[-1][0,-1] - ALREADY post-ln_f in HuggingFace GPT-2; W_U @ z == the model's own logits (checked < 0.001 per fact)
manifest.h_is: the raw pre-ln_f residual stream, from a forward hook on ln_f's input
manifest.not_rome: The fold is a bare rank-one write with no covariance pre-conditioning, so its collateral damage is an UPPER BOUND on a ROME/MEMIT edit's, not an estimate of it.
manifest.lane_numbers_not_reproduced: The lane's 294/148/208 (GPT-2 XL weights-vs-slots) and 611/650 (GPT-2 medium retention) were measured elsewhere; a search of this machine's code tree on 2026-11-25 found no such code here. Nothing here reproduces or displays them.

fold.method: rank-one write W' = W + outer(k, delta)/dot(k,k) on transformer.h[8].mlp.c_proj; NOT ROME/MEMIT - no covariance pre-conditioning
fold.taught_prompt: The mother tongue of Danielle Darrieux is
fold.fold_layer_choice: AUTHORED hyperparameter (layer 8 of 24), not a ported value: a mid-network MLP. Declared, never presented as measured.

relation_locality.max_is_not_a_rule: 1 of 8 untaught facts move FURTHER than the taught fact's 2.7841; the other 7 move less. The maximum is not a rule and must not be written as one.
relation_locality.what_would_settle_it: the same fold repeated across several taught relations, with a balanced same-relation and different-relation control set per fold. NOT RUN - this is one prompt, one fold, one layer.
relation_locality.reading: Grouped by relation, the damage is LOCAL. Untaught facts sharing the taught relation P103 (n=4) move 2.7771 on average - within 0.0069 of the taught fact's own 2.7841 - while facts of other relations (n=4) move 1.1911, a factor of 2.33. This is a SHAPE at n=4 vs n=4 on one prompt, one fold, one layer; it is not an effect size and must not be cited as one.

projections.label: Decision plane (true / wrong unembedding rows)
projections.discards: everything orthogonal to both unembedding rows. Axis 3 is the leftover direction of the miss case's own z, so the plane is the decision and the depth is that one vector; any other vector's out-of-plane part is reported as its own number, not drawn.

projections.label: PCA over this dump's z vectors (19 facts)
projections.discards: the 2.2% of between-fact variance outside the top 3 components, and the mean vector, which is subtracted before the fit.

projections.label: Random orthonormal basis (seed 20261125) - the honesty control
projections.discards: all but 3 of 1024 dimensions, chosen with no regard to the data. If the picture looks structured HERE, the structure in the other projections is an artifact of the basis, not of the model. This axis exists to be compared against, not believed.

projections.label: Raw dimensions 909, 433, 671 (highest between-fact variance)
projections.discards: the other 1021 coordinates entirely. Nothing is mixed, so a coordinate here is literally one number out of the vector.
